description: This PHP class 'Stats' provides methods for retrieving and caching various statistical data related to users, projects, investments, calls, and matchfunding within the Goteo platform. It includes methods for total counts, percentages, and detailed financial calculations, utilizing external model classes and a caching library.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: A class providing methods to retrieve and cache statistical data related to users, projects, investments, calls, and matchfunding in the Goteo platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Stats object with a Cacher instance and optional TTL.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a Stats instance with a named cache and TTL.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method to intercept calls to methods without 'get' prefix, adding caching behavior.

methods.name: getTotalMoneyFunded
methods.description: Returns total money funded through investments.

methods.name: getMatchfundingRaised
methods.description: Returns total amount raised through call and matcher matchfunding.

methods.name: getMatchfundingSucessfulPercentage
methods.description: Returns percentage of successful matchfunded projects.

methods.name: getMatchfundingOwnersGender
methods.description: Returns gender distribution of matchfunding owners.

methods.name: getInvestTotals
methods.description: Returns cached or fresh list of investment totals based on filters.

methods.name: getInvestFees
methods.description: Calculates and returns total fees, VAT, and total amount for investments based on filters.

methods.name: getInvestAmounts
methods.description: Returns investment amounts grouped into ranges with percentages.

methods.name: getProjectTotals
methods.description: Returns list of projects based on filters.
